reviews.evidence: The number2 Vertán quarter explicitly includes the Vertán estate, together with Bánom, Újhegy, Ardics and Kenyérváró.

The text distinguishes the proper Honvéd estate parcelled in1861 from the quarter northwestern Kisbécs part, which already had small plots about180years earlier. This supports a broader quarter containing the proper estate and an older smaller part; identical extents are not established.
